title: HullQ SLICE-0022 Retained Artifact Digests
description: Deterministic, non-self-referential SHA256 digests of the SLICE-0022 offline retained output files (manifest.json, manifest_schema.json, REPORT.md). Excludes ARTIFACT-DIGESTS.json itself to avoid a self-referential digest loop, and excludes PostgreSQL replay evidence (REPLAY-RESULT.json/REPLAY-REPORT.md), which is produced only by a separate --replay run and is verified by the replay-safety gate instead.
